title: Learning to bid and bundle: a posterior-sampling agent for online retail
summary: In a simulated online-retail setting, posterior sampling learns bid/discount decisions under censored feedback; the paper reports that frequent discount waiting can be mistaken for lost demand and bias market inference. No real customer spending is measured.
ai_technology: a posterior-sampling agent updates market beliefs from decision-censored data and chooses a solved seasonal plan
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: In a simulated online-retail setting, posterior sampling learns bid/discount decisions under censored feedback; the paper reports that frequent discount waiting can be mistaken for lost demand and bias market inference. No real customer spending is measured. Evaluation: simulated online florist under defined market conditions, comparison policies and waiting/discount interventions
evidence.unknown: No real customer spending or deployment was measured; the finding is confined to the simulated market and censored-feedback setting.
evidence.ai_role: a posterior-sampling agent updates market beliefs from decision-censored data and chooses a solved seasonal plan.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
